attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers, chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs to 750 and files to 640 (no access for others), and verified original file contents/checksums were preserved. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, triggered a native reboot, confirmed connection drop then recovery, proved boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership, permissions, and unchanged data after restart.
